name: 现场物流计划与执行 (40G)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item supports the logistics between a supplying base and remote locations – receiving products needed for maintenance operations at the base and forwarding them to the remote location, as well as return from the remote location back to the base.

This covers the following supply scenarios:

• Stock located at remote and base locations

• Stock located at base location only

• Stock located at remote location only

• Direct purchase

The process covers the following return scenarios:

• Return to base inventory

• Return to vendor

• Return for inspection

• Return for repair/recertification

• Temporary storage

Key Process Flow

• Create maintenance order for remote location

• Trigger stock transfer process from base location to remote location

• Create purchase order for base location

• Create inbound and outbound delivery (logistics and warehouse management at base)

• Create handling unit

• Receive items at base with a common browser mobile-enabled UI, using QR code scan to receive

• Print labels

• Post goods receipt at base and remote, supported by the field logistics Process Receipts and Process Cross-Plants Receipts apps, using QR code scan to identify

• Post goods issue against maintenance order

• Initiate returns process

• Pack returned items into a container and post goods issue, using QR code scan to pack

• Process returns at base location

Business Benefits

  • Configure and execute supply and return processing between supplying base and remote locations
  • Integrate supply processing with plant maintenance, materials management, procurement, warehouse management at base location, and logistics
  • Integrate returns processing with materials management, procurement, warehouse management, and logistics
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目支持供应基地和远程位置之间的物流 - 接收基地维护操作所需的产品并将其转发到远程位置，以及从远程位置返回到基地。

这涵盖以下供应场景：

• 位于远程和基本位置的库存

• 仅基地处的库存

• 库存仅位于远程位置

• 直接采购

该流程涵盖以下退货场景：

• 退货到基础库存

• 退货给供应商

• 退货检验

• 修复/重新认证退货

• 临时存储

关键流程流

• 为远程位置创建维护订单

• 触发从基地到远程位置的库存转储流程

• 创建基地采购订单

• 创建入库和出库交货（基地物流和仓库管理）

• 创建处理单元

• 通过支持移动设备的通用用户界面在基地接收项目，使用二维码扫描进行接收

• 打印标签

• 在基地和远程过账收货，由现场物流“处理收货”和“处理跨工厂收货”应用支持，使用二维码扫描进行识别

• 根据维护订单过账发货

• 启动退货流程

• 将退货项目装入容器并过账发货，使用二维码扫描进行打包

• 在基地处理退货

业务优势

  • 配置和执行供应基地与远程位置之间的供应和退货处理。
  • 将供应处理与工厂维护、物料管理、采购、基地仓库管理和物流相集成
  • 将退货处理与物料管理、采购、仓库管理和物流相集成
